name: application-attribution-bar
title: Attribution Bar
description: Horizontal stacked bar showing conversion or revenue attribution by channel, with a matching legend listing each channel's color, label, and percentage.
useWhen: Showing how conversions or revenue break down across a small, fixed set of marketing channels.
The channels are categorical (identity), not an ordered magnitude scale, so each gets a distinct hue.
A compact single-row visual plus an exact-percentage legend is more useful than a full pie or donut chart.
avoidWhen: There are more than about 5-6 channels — a stacked bar this thin becomes unreadable; use a table instead.
You need to compare attribution across multiple time periods — pair this with a grouped/small-multiples layout rather than a single bar.
The values are magnitudes on a shared scale, not parts of a 100% whole — use a bar chart instead of a stacked one.
responsiveBehavior: The bar and legend are a fixed w-80 block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The stacked bar itself is role="img" with a full text summary of every channel and percentage as its aria-label, since the visual segments alone convey nothing to screen readers.
The legend list repeats every value as visible text, so no information exists only in the bar's proportional widths.
Each channel is assigned a fixed, distinct hue (not color-cycled) so channel identity stays consistent if the list is reordered.

variants.title: Attribution bar
variants.description: Four-channel conversion attribution bar (Paid search, Organic search, Referral, Direct) with a matching legend and percentages.
accessibility: Legend swatches use the same colors as the bar segments, keeping the color-to-channel mapping consistent.

variants.title: Attribution bar (Dark)
variants.description: Attribution bar adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Channel colors are lightened relative to the light variant to remain distinguishable against the dark surface.
